description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_Ip class, which validates IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with configurable options for allowing IPv4 and IPv6. It includes methods for setting options, validating IP addresses, and internal validation for IPv4 and IPv6 formats.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Ip
classes.description: A class for validating IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with configurable options for allowing each IP version.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes validator options, accepting arrays, Zend_Config objects, or individual arguments for IPv6 and IPv4 allowance.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the current configuration options for IP validation.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets the validation options, enabling or disabling IPv4 and IPv6 validation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a valid IP address based on current options.

methods.name: _validateIPv4
methods.description: Internal method to validate IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: _validateIPv6
methods.description: Internal method to validate IPv6 addresses.
